evidence.quote: As discussed on Zulip, please be sure to set the `signal.data.collection` to `.` [value partly stripped in page; a fully qualified name]

notes: A Kafka-signal incremental snapshot silently does nothing because signal.data.collection is not fully qualified. The signal/watermark code needs the source signal table name.
